PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(npm run dev|pnpm( run)? dev|yarn dev|bun run dev)"

hooks.command: node -e "console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux for log access');console.error('[Hook] Use: tmux new-session -d -s dev \"npm run dev\"');console.error('[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev');process.exit(1)"

PreToolUse.description: Block dev servers outside tmux - ensures you can access logs

hooks.command: node -e "if(!process.env.TMUX){console.error('[Hook] Consider running in tmux for session persistence');console.error('[Hook] tmux new -s dev  |  tmux attach -t dev')}"

PreToolUse.description: Reminder to use tmux for long-running commands

SessionStart.description: Load previous context and detect package manager on new session
